steps: 1. In a solo Adventure mission, wield a weapon whose properties/trait you can identify. Record the exact item and its held-Tab values.
2. Use public CIM's standard crafting bench with Allow Craft Bench enabled to reforge that same equipped instance. Do not swap, re-equip, change career or force a session refresh.
3. Compare the reforged item's actual properties/trait with held Tab immediately. Repeat the reforge and comparison once.
4. Reforge a different, unequipped instance of the same weapon type. Confirm this does not replace the currently wielded item's held-Tab values.
5. Only after those controls, swap away/back and transition maps; confirm the currently wielded item's values remain correct.
assertions: Held Tab refreshes the exact equipped instance's properties/trait after reforge without re-equipping. A different instance cannot supply its values, and later swaps/transitions stay correct.
Mutate properties of the equipped backend instance, wait one refresh interval, read the Tab row widget: updated; mutate another instance: unchanged.
